verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Blinding Dart range and trade autos into his poison; you win if you time your E-into-Q all-in for the 8 seconds after his Q is spent.

brief.thesis: Every source of Teemo's damage — Q (Blinding Dart), E (Toxic Shot), and R (Noxious Trap) — is magic, and his only answer to Irelia's engage is the blind on Q, which stops autoattacks but does nothing to spell damage. Since Irelia's stun (E, Flawless Duet) and gap-close (Q, Bladesurge) are both spells, she can force the fight exactly when his Blinding Dart is down, which is why the lane sits at a near-even 50.3% over 1160 games with a measured solo-kill edge in her favor.

theirWindow.what: He baits you into range and lands Blinding Dart (8s cooldown, 680 range) before you swing, denying your autoattacks and passive attack-speed stacking while he free-hits you with E (Toxic Shot).

yourWindow.what: Flash E (Flawless Duet, 850 range) through him for the stun and Mark, then Q (Bladesurge) dashes in free since it refreshes off a Marked target — he has no blind for 8 seconds to stop the follow-up autos.

boots.why: 53.6% win rate over 1098 games, 80.5% pick — every one of his damage sources (Q, E, R) is magic, so flat magic resist directly counters his whole kit.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended autoattack-and-spell trades this lane produces and the healing conversion keeps you ahead of his poison ticks during the all-in.

summoners.why: 53% win rate and 77.5% pick — Ignite's damage ignores his low sustain and closes out the kill in the window right after his Q is spent, converting your solo-kill edge into an actual kill.

playing.title: Chain E into Q, not autos
playing.detail: Blinding Dart only blocks autoattacks — Flawless Duet's stun and Bladesurge's dash damage are spells, so they go through even if he lands the blind.

playing.title: All-in right after his Q
playing.detail: His Blinding Dart is on an 8 second cooldown with 680 range; commit your engage the moment you see it fire, not before.

playing.title: Poke from 850, not 680
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's range outreaches both his autoattacks and Blinding Dart, so you can threaten the stun from a distance he can't punish.

playing.title: Respect mushrooms in brush
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1 second cooldown and 230 range, so he can carpet tri-bush and river entrances — don't walk blind into unwarded brush.

playing.title: Deprioritize W against his all-magic kit
playing.detail: Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage taken, which does nothing against Q, E, or R — this is why the common skill order (QEWQQRQWQWRWWEE) levels W last; follow it here.

playing.title: Itemize magic resist early
playing.detail: Mercury's Treads and Wit's End are your actual counters to his poke, not W — rush them over pure damage if his poison starts adding up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning — why the Q-cooldown window works and why W is deprioritized — is my own read of the ability mechanics, not a stat.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb Jayce’s damage with a well-timed [W]. Easily get a kill by landing [E] successfully whenever Irelia has [P] stacks prepared.
